reason: Most of the weight is on the 'Mandatory service for all' bills (rows 1-3, 8, 12), extending civilian reserve duty (4), requiring call-up of those currently not summoned (5, 16), and narrowing exemptions or widening the draft (11, 13, 14). These are exactly 'everyone, including groups exempt today, serves'. The 'away' bills (exemption for women 6, abolishing conscription 7/15, conscientious-objector exemption 9/10) are the natural opposite side of the same question. The statement names its price, keeps to one idea and is under 25 words, so no change is needed.
